properties.name: delulu:note
properties.value: Direct third-party dependencies of the workspace, with the versions resolved in the committed Cargo.lock. Transitive dependencies are enumerated by that lockfile, which is the authoritative and complete record; this document lists what the workspace itself declares. An SBOM that omits something linked into the binary is worse than none, because it will be trusted — so the omission is stated here rather than left to be discovered.
